reason: Product bug, not a flaky test: submitting feedback saves the row, but the panel never flips Add Feedback -> Edit Feedback. row.feedback comes from the usage read, which is served from the exact-aggregation snapshot cached before the feedback existed; read_or_schedule_exact_snapshot returns that cache hit without rescheduling unless refresh is set. Un-quarantine once the usage read is invalidated or refreshed after a feedback mutation.
